references.text: Details about Jesus' birth and how Joseph, mentioned as his father in verse 16, reacts to the news of Mary's pregnancy.
The genealogy in Luke which also mentions Joseph but provides a different lineage leading to Jesus.
The prophecy that a ruler will come from Judah, which is relevant for Jesus' genealogy and his identification as the Messiah.
The prophecy about a virgin who will give birth to a son, fulfilled in Jesus' birth from Mary.
The prophecy of a righteous branch from David who will reign, pointing forward to Jesus' royal and messianic role.
